segments.en: After Hashem Yisburach has done so much good for us — to make us hear such novelties of Torah — the like of which have never been heard — which give life to all souls from the greatest to the smallest. Since through the kindnesses of Hashem He has opened our eyes and made known to us somewhat the truth of his greatness — certainly for a single (light) movement — to draw close to us. All the more so — to study his holy books and to fulfill some true word from his words. Certainly for a single point — it is worthwhile and worthwhile to bear everything — and to shatter all the obstacles in the world — in these our generations.
